lore_echoes.name: Crypt Builder's Memory
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: The walls remember their maker. Stone by stone, I sealed my own tomb.

lore_echoes.name: Forest Guardian's Lament
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: Once, these woods sang with life. Now only shadows remain.

lore_echoes.name: Meadow Battle Memory
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: Steel clashed here. The grass still weeps for the fallen.

lore_echoes.name: Ancient Warning
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: Beware the sealed door. What sleeps beyond hungers still.
